component.name: BlockAds
component.summary: Block ads, trackers, malware and phishing for the whole computer
Bloqueie anúncios, rastreadores, malware e phishing no computador inteiro

description.p: BlockAds filters the DNS of the whole computer with the same filter lists as BlockAds for Android. A sandboxed service answers DNS; a small helper redirects port 53 to it with firewall rules and removes them whenever the service stops, so the network keeps working.
Nothing leaves the computer except the queries to the DNS servers you chose and the downloads of the filter lists you enabled.
